name: MATRIX
recent: Matrix Concepts 近期以 RM169.3m 收购柔佛 Kulai 约 174.8 公顷农业地，用于扩大 Johor 业务版图；同时于 Sendayan 动土兴建护理设施，并公布 MVV 2.0 综合城镇策略。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比增 11.0%，净利同比减 4.4%，但净利环比大增 55.5%。
notable: 以 RM169,313,523 收购柔佛 Kulai 57 幅农业地，总面积约 174.7749 公顷。
在 Sendayan 动土兴建护理设施。
公布 MVV 2.0 综合城镇发展策略，并预计 Kulai 工业项目 GDV 达 RM1.07b。
risks: 执行副主席 Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock 在多个日期申报买卖公司股份，包括在闭门期内的交易。
2026-09-15 公告涉及其他证券发行（OTHER ISSUE OF SECURITIES），可能涉及新股发行。

recent_en: Matrix Concepts recently acquired about 174.8 hectares of agriculture land in Kulai, Johor for RM169.3m to expand its Johor footprint; it also broke ground on a nursing care facility in Sendayan and outlined its MVV 2.0 integrated township strategy. In the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue rose 11.0% YoY while net profit fell 4.4% YoY, though net profit jumped 55.5% QoQ.
notable_en: Acquired 57 agriculture land parcels totaling about 174.7749 hectares in Kulai, Johor for RM169,313,523.
Broke ground on a nursing care facility in Sendayan.
Outlined the MVV 2.0 integrated township strategy and projected RM1.07b industrial GDV for the Kulai project.
risks_en: Group Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock reported multiple acquisitions of shares, including dealings during the closed period.
The 2026-09-15 announcement involves an OTHER ISSUE OF SECURITIES, which may involve a new share issuance.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM315.578m, up 11.0% YoY and 2.2% QoQ; net profit was RM60.189m, down 4.4% YoY but up 55.5% QoQ; net margin was 19.1%, higher than 12.5% in the previous quarter.
